speaker: Simon
text: Cold.

speaker: Simon
text: That's not the schedule. We should still be under.

speaker: Simon
text: Hands work. Legs work. Good enough.

speaker: Simon
text: Technician's me, I guess.

speaker: Simon
text: Mine. Still warm. Last in the line.

speaker: Simon
text: Last bay. Last night of the install.

speaker: Simon
text: Someone's still in there. Not for long.

speaker: Simon
text: Code's on the panel. And a tag. 'Final bay load check: OK. Simon.'

speaker: Simon
text: Simon. That's me. I was so tired.

speaker: Simon
text: My stamp. My signature.

speaker: Simon
text: I should have walked the whole run. I didn't.

speaker: Simon
text: I signed it. I signed it.

speaker: Simon
text: Four digits. Standard Guild panel. I wired a hundred of these.

speaker: Simon
text: Come on. Four digits.

speaker: Simon
text: The numbers keep moving. Steady.

speaker: Simon
text: Not that one.

speaker: Simon
text: Not that. Think.

speaker: Simon
text: Wrong. It's wrong. Again.

speaker: Simon
text: Sealed from the other side.

speaker: Simon
text: Open.

speaker: Minerva
text: You're awake. Slowly. You'll be dizzy. I saw your pod come online on my monitor and ran.

speaker: Simon
text: You're not in a pod.

speaker: Minerva
text: No. I'm on the science team. The trip is my research. Or it was.

speaker: Minerva
text: Crew sleep in rotation. A hundred and twenty days up, then you go under so the dark doesn't get you. I should have gone under a year ago.

speaker: Simon
text: What happened to everyone?

speaker: Minerva
text: The pods failed, one at a time. The people in them didn't die. They woke up wrong. You'll see.

speaker: Simon
text: Wrong how?

speaker: Minerva
text: I've been watching your vitals from my room. Everyone around me has been going mad, and I'm not sure why. The signs start around the eyes. Then you start seeing things. Then the things get worse. Everyone becoming... more... less...

speaker: Minerva
text: Anyway! You're awake. That's what matters.

speaker: Simon
text: Signs of what? How long have I got?

speaker: Minerva
text: About a quarter of an hour before your body stops fighting it. Less, actually. Your clock started before you woke. The signal was working on you before you noticed.

speaker: Simon
text: A quarter of an hour. Less. Fine. I've worked worse deadlines.

speaker: Minerva
text: Something odd. The others eased for a while after the violent episodes. The things they saw went quiet. I don't understand it. Take that however you like.

speaker: Simon
text: What happens when the clock runs out?

speaker: Minerva
text: I don't know. I've only seen it from far away. There's something. Don't ask me to describe it.

speaker: Minerva
text: Take this map of Zone 1. Press M to look at it. I've patched your access to the hub doors.

speaker: Simon
text: Why help me?

speaker: Minerva
text: Because I'd rather not be the only one left who can still talk.

speaker: Simon
text: You seem fine. Why aren't you like the others?

speaker: Minerva
text: I take something. A prescription, from home. It keeps the edges soft. I'm running low.

speaker: Minerva
text: Maybe it's that. Maybe it's luck. Don't ask me why.

speaker: Minerva
text: Stay out of the dark corners. The main hub is through that door. It's quiet there. I'll meet you.

speaker: Simon
text: I'll be there.

speaker: Simon
text: Big room for a ship this size.

speaker: Simon
text: Some kind of showpiece. Expensive.

speaker: Minerva
text: Told you it's quiet. It's the only room that is.

speaker: Minerva
text: I should say who I am. Minerva. Signal analysis, mostly. It was supposed to be the quiet job.

speaker: Simon
text: Simon. Welder. Engineers' Guild.

speaker: Minerva
text: A welder. Then you know the bones of this ship better than I do.

speaker: Minerva
text: I'm from a small town. My dad wanted me to go further than he did. This trip was my one real chance. A paper, a future.

speaker: Simon
text: No stars I know.

speaker: Minerva
text: There aren't any. Not ones with names.

speaker: Minerva
text: Don't look too long. It isn't the dark that gets you. It's how far.

speaker: Minerva
text: Tea? It's the last real tea on the ship. I've been saving it for company.

speaker: Simon
text: Real? Not the powder?

speaker: Minerva
text: Real. Don't tell Deimos. He'd write a report.

speaker: Simon
text: So what now?

speaker: Minerva
text: You need time. I can't make it. But Deimos might.

speaker: Minerva
text: He's the chief engineer. He's been working on something with the drive for months. If anyone can find a way to buy you more time, it's him.

speaker: Simon
text: Then why aren't you there?

speaker: Minerva
text: He doesn't answer my knocks anymore. And the drive corridor, the hum bothers me. He's Guild, though. He might talk to another tradesman.

speaker: Simon
text: Where?

speaker: Minerva
text: East, past the drive corridor. It's on your map. Look for the door ringed with lead beams. There's a peephole. He won't open the door for anyone. Go quietly. It's full of them. Also.. if you hear 'it' whatever you do don't listen to what it wants..

speaker: Simon
text: ...What's 'it'? What does it want?

speaker: Minerva
text: Hm? Oh, nothing. Just be careful out there.

speaker: Simon
text: I'll go.

speaker: Minerva
text: Come back after and tell me what he says. I keep watching them, so I can tell you where it's safe.

speaker: Deimos
text: Who's there?

speaker: Simon
text: Simon. Minerva sent me.

speaker: Deimos
text: Minerva. She knocks. She wants to talk about the signal. I'd rather not.

speaker: Deimos
text: Hold up your wrist to the shutter.

speaker: Deimos
text: A Guild stamp on that wristband. I didn't think I'd see another.

speaker: Simon
text: Guild man. Good.

speaker: Deimos
text: Good. I don't open the door. Not to anyone. You've seen the marks on it.

speaker: Simon
text: The scratches.

speaker: Deimos
text: They come at night. They want in. In here I'm safe. Mostly.

speaker: Simon
text: Quiet at the door. The hum dropped off.

speaker: Deimos
text: Lead. The old way. It keeps the room honest.

speaker: Simon
text: Minerva says the signal did this. All of it.

speaker: Deimos
text: The signal didn't do anything, Simon. It has no interest in us. That's what the others never understood. Something hostile, you could hate. We were standing where it happened to be listening.

speaker: Simon
text: Listening for what?

speaker: Deimos
text: That is the question I can't leave alone.

speaker: Simon
text: What are you building in there?

speaker: Deimos
text: A coupling regulator. It evens the load between the drive and the loop.

speaker: Deimos
text: The drive's been running rough. If I finish this, I can steady the loop. Power for the pods. Life support. Real time, maybe.

speaker: Simon
text: A cure?

speaker: Deimos
text: No. There's no cure. Time. That's all anyone gets.

speaker: Simon
text: What do you need?

speaker: Deimos
text: A wrench. A length of the heavy plate from the maintenance bay. Put them in the drawer under the shutter. I can't go out there myself. Not anymore.

speaker: Simon
text: Why not?

speaker: Deimos
text: The hum is louder out there. In here, I can think.

speaker: Simon
text: Property of Deimos. He left it here. Trusted it to hang until someone came.

speaker: Simon
text: Torque-rated. Somebody looked after this.

speaker: Simon
text: Forty millimeter. Heavy. Figures.

speaker: Simon
text: Stores C. Someone cut the padlock from below. I'll leave it.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: First delivery, and two things from Minerva
text: Good steel. Thank you.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: First delivery, and two things from Minerva
text: Good steel. Hurry the next one. It's harder to hear yourself think out there, isn't it?

speaker: Deimos
section_title: First delivery, and two things from Minerva
text: In the drawer. THE DRAWER. It likes the weight. Faster.

speaker: Simon
section_title: First delivery, and two things from Minerva
text: Warm air coming out of the shutter. It wasn't before.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: First delivery, and two things from Minerva
text: Next, two things from Minerva. A vial of the calibration fluid she used on the signal readings, for flushing the coolant lines. And one sentence, into this.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: First delivery, and two things from Minerva
text: She says it exactly: 'I am Minerva, and I am awake, and I am listening.' A voice check for the intercom.

speaker: Simon
section_title: First delivery, and two things from Minerva
text: That fluid's for sensors. And a sentence, for an intercom?

speaker: Deimos
section_title: First delivery, and two things from Minerva
text: Clean and inert, and a voice that means what it says. Calibration needs both.

speaker: Minerva
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: You're back. What did he say?

speaker: Simon
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: He thinks he can steady the drive. Power for the pods and life support. Real time.

speaker: Minerva
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: Time.

speaker: Minerva
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: That's more than I've managed. Just remember he's been alone in there a long time.

speaker: Simon
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: Deimos wants a vial of your calibration fluid. And a sentence from you, for the intercom. Into this.

speaker: Minerva
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: My calibration fluid? For coolant?

speaker: Minerva
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: Odd. Take it. I've finished with it for now.

speaker: Simon
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: 'I am Minerva, and I am awake, and I am listening.'

speaker: Minerva
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: That's... an odd thing to ask for an intercom.

speaker: Minerva
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: I am Minerva, and I am awake, and I am listening.
note: Recorded sentence. She laughs once and reads it clearly

speaker: Minerva
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: There. Happy?

speaker: Minerva
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: I am Minerva, and I am awake, and I am listening.
note: Recorded sentence. She stops halfway, looks at the recorder, and finishes in a smaller voice

speaker: Minerva
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: I am Minerva, and I am awake, and I am listening.
note: Recorded sentence. Her voice arrives half a second late, with a second voice under it that is a little too calm. The hub's hum catches the note and holds it

speaker: Simon
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: That didn't sound like you.

speaker: Minerva
section_title: Minerva, the vial and the recording
text: It sounded exactly like me. That's what I don't like.

speaker: Simon
text: Your lamp's got a loose lead. Give me a minute.

speaker: Simon
text: Ten seconds.

speaker: Minerva
text: You fixed my lamp. I've been staring at that flicker for a week.

speaker: Minerva
text: Thank you. I mean it. Nobody's fixed anything for me in a long time.

speaker: Simon
text: Tell me about the headphones.

speaker: Minerva
text: My dad made them. He works with materials. He never told me what the cups are lined with. He said they'd help me concentrate. I wore them to launch. I haven't taken them off since.

speaker: Minerva
text: And the tablets. One a day, since I was nineteen. I counted this morning. I'm not telling you the number.

speaker: Minerva
text: I haven't told him I'm not coming back.

speaker: Minerva
text: Tell me about yours. Your family.

speaker: Minerva
text: You don't have to tell me. But it helps to say it.

speaker: Minerva
text: Say it quickly. I might not remember.

speaker: Simon
text: Nora. Nine. Draws horses with too many legs. She says that's how they run.

speaker: Minerva
text: I'd buy one.

speaker: Simon
text: She'd charge you.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The vial and the recording delivered, and the pillow
text: Perfect. The coupling takes it like it was thirsty. And her voice, so warm. It's exactly what it needs.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The vial and the recording delivered, and the pillow
text: Beautiful. She has such a good voice. I can't wait to give the ship my life.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The vial and the recording delivered, and the pillow
text: A figure of speech. Habit.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The vial and the recording delivered, and the pillow
text: It's learning her. LISTEN. Listen! She had it in her all along.

speaker: Simon
section_title: The vial and the recording delivered, and the pillow
text: There's frost on the inside of the shutter. In a room that warm.

speaker: Simon
section_title: The vial and the recording delivered, and the pillow
text: Your family? The photo.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The vial and the recording delivered, and the pillow
text: Marisol. My son's a plumber. My daughter teaches. They're in Bay Four, asleep. I wrote on it the day we passed the halfway mark. 'Almost home.' It was a joke, then.

speaker: Simon
section_title: The vial and the recording delivered, and the pillow
text: Bay Four. Are they...

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The vial and the recording delivered, and the pillow
text: Holding. For now. That is what this is for.

speaker: Simon
section_title: The vial and the recording delivered, and the pillow
text: Almost home. I'd have written it too.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The vial and the recording delivered, and the pillow
text: Next. The pods use a foam headrest. The foam is the right density for the damper. Take one from a pod that's already failed. They won't miss it.

speaker: Simon
section_title: The vial and the recording delivered, and the pillow
text: Foam for a damper? From a pod with a person in it?

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The vial and the recording delivered, and the pillow
text: Density, Simon. Just density.

speaker: Minerva
text: Day 1,071. A pattern in the background noise. Too regular to be noise. I checked it a hundred times.

speaker: Minerva
text: It doesn't sound like anything. It isn't sound. It felt like being invited.

speaker: Minerva
text: I still think it might be worth knowing about.

speaker: Minerva
text: I used to think I understood it.

speaker: Minerva
text: It understood me first.

speaker: Deimos
text: You have children?

speaker: Simon
text: A daughter. Nine.

speaker: Deimos
text: Nine. They still think you can lift the ship.

speaker: Simon
text: She'll learn.

speaker: Deimos
text: She will. Better she learns slowly.

speaker: Simon
text: Another bay. The pods go back farther than the light.

speaker: Simon
text: Don't look in. Just take the pad.

speaker: Simon
text: Their lips are moving. They aren't. They're not.

speaker: Simon
text: They're all awake. They've been awake the whole time.

speaker: It
text: Stay.

speaker: It
text: You are not alone. You are never alone. That is the kindness of it.

speaker: Simon
text: Sorry. I need it.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The pillow delivered, and the last piece
text: Dense, as I hoped. Thank you.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The pillow delivered, and the last piece
text: Still warm? No. It never is. Forgive me. Quickly now.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The pillow delivered, and the last piece
text: They're dreaming in there. Did you hear them dreaming? Don't stop. Don't stop now.

speaker: Simon
section_title: The pillow delivered, and the last piece
text: It's humming through the shutter. Almost a word.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The pillow delivered, and the last piece
text: You're a good man, Simon. I'm glad it was you who woke.

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The pillow delivered, and the last piece
text: One last piece. The emitter core. It's a lattice cylinder the length of your hand. It went missing from Stores C when I put the order in.

speaker: Simon
section_title: The pillow delivered, and the last piece
text: Missing?

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The pillow delivered, and the last piece
text: Innox. The stores hand. He took it down there and he's been there since. He's changed. He's gone furthest of any of them. Take what you need and come back.

speaker: Simon
section_title: The pillow delivered, and the last piece
text: Take it how?

speaker: Deimos
section_title: The pillow delivered, and the last piece
text: Any way you have to.

speaker: Simon
text: Twelve pods. Three wiped clean.

speaker: Simon
text: Colder in here. The vents are blowing warm. It's colder.

speaker: Simon
text: A folding chair. A blanket folded on the seat. A ring on the floor where a thermos stood and the dust is gone.

speaker: Simon
text: Somebody sat here every day. Until he couldn't.

speaker: Simon
text: The chair faces the glass. Their faces are turned to the chair.

speaker: Simon
text: All three lights pulse together, on the beat of the hum. Then on mine.

speaker: Simon
text: All three are turned toward the door. They're smiling. Pods don't do that.

speaker: It
text: Hold still.

speaker: Simon
text: A hand-built coupling. His. It's already running on them.

speaker: Simon
text: Same pattern as the drive log. Row for row.

speaker: Simon
text: He said 'holding.' He didn't say what for.

speaker: Simon
text: I should have sat in a chair like this. For a recital.

speaker: Simon
text: The frost is on the outside. The inside was already clear. Somebody's been looking out.

speaker: Simon
text: Her eyes are open. They're on the chair.

speaker: Minerva
text: I'll tell you the rest.

speaker: Minerva
text: Day 1,078. I wrote the request in four minutes. Just a few more months. A closer pass. There was a box on the form to put off our rest, so we could stay awake with it. I ticked it. I sent it.

speaker: Minerva
text: It came back in four seconds. 'Fine. Don't make it a thing.' I thought: good. Then I thought: he didn't read it.

speaker: Simon
text: And you went ahead.

speaker: Minerva
text: Yes. I went ahead.

speaker: Minerva
text: Signal strength went up 340 percent. I told myself that's what a closer pass does. Then the pods started failing. It doesn't matter how I run the numbers.

speaker: Simon
text: You couldn't have known.

speaker: Minerva
text: That's what I tell myself. 'I couldn't have known.' It sounds more like a sentence than a defense.

speaker: Simon
text: I signed off the bay I woke up in. I didn't walk the full run.

speaker: Minerva
text: ...We all signed something.

speaker: Simon
text: I told myself I had nothing back there. That the ship was a second chance.

speaker: Minerva
text: And?

speaker: Simon
text: I missed my daughter's recital. A double shift. I told myself I'd make it up to her.

speaker: Minerva
text: Did you?

speaker: Simon
text: I got on a ship.

speaker: Minerva
text: Take them. They're the only thing that's ever made it quiet. Maybe they'll do that for you.

speaker: Simon
text: You'll be without them.

speaker: Minerva
text: I'm fine in my room. I've still got a few tablets. Bring them back when you're done.

speaker: Simon
text: Heavier than they look.

speaker: Simon
text: The hum's softer. Like a hand over a speaker.

speaker: Simon
text: It's not gone. It's just... farther.

speaker: Simon
text: Someone's been living down here.

speaker: Simon
text: 'No one is coming.' 'I checked.' That's what I'd write.

speaker: Innox
text: —st... stop... there—

speaker: Simon
text: That's a voice. They talk now.

speaker: Innox
text: —he sent... you—

speaker: Simon
text: Stay where you are.

speaker: Innox
text: —not... letting... him—
true_text: I'm not letting him build it.

speaker: Simon
text: The hum's dull. Like it's far off.

speaker: Simon
text: That hum goes straight through my teeth.

speaker: Innox
text: NNgh... back...

speaker: Innox
text: —plea... plea—

speaker: Innox
text: —the door... his door—
true_text: I have to get to his door.

speaker: Innox
text: Don't give it to him.

speaker: Simon
text: No.

speaker: Simon
text: They were people. They were all people.

speaker: Simon
text: They thought I was the monster. They were scared of me.

speaker: Simon
text: I shouldn't feel better. I do.

speaker: Simon
text: He was wearing a name badge.

speaker: Simon
text: 'I'm not letting him build it.' He said that. I heard 'ngh.'

speaker: Simon
text: A cylinder. Lattice alloy. Stamped STORES C-9.

speaker: Simon
text: The emitter core. He had it on him the whole time.

speaker: Simon
text: Sorry, Innox.

speaker: Simon
text: 'He'll send someone.' He knew I was coming.

speaker: Minerva
text: You're shaking. Sit. You've been down there.

speaker: Minerva
text: Oh. You've been busy.

speaker: Simon
text: The hum's louder here. In the corridor. It wasn't this loud at the door before.

speaker: Deimos
text: You're quiet. Did you find what I asked for?

speaker: Deimos
text: You took your time. Did you find it?

speaker: Deimos
text: I heard you in the corridor. Did you bring it? THE CORE. Did you bring it?

speaker: Deimos
text: Someone wiped Marisol's glass. The camera in Bay Four showed me. Thank you. She hasn't had a clear view in some time.

speaker: Simon
text: Innox said, 'Don't give it to him.' What are you building?

speaker: Deimos
text: A regulator, Simon. Power for the pods. I told you.

speaker: Deimos
text: A voice. It has been listening to us for three years. It is only fair that something answers. Nobody has to be alone with it.

speaker: Deimos
text: An amplifier. Earth hears it. Every house. Every school. All of them, hearing it together. Nobody alone. Everyone, Simon. You too. Give it to me.

speaker: Simon
text: Earth. Nora's on Earth.

speaker: Deimos
text: Then she will hear it too. Isn't that what you wanted? To be near her?

speaker: Simon
text: Earth's already dying.

speaker: Deimos
text: Slowly. One house at a time, in the dark, alone. I have read the models. I would end the alone.

speaker: Simon
text: They were people, Deimos. The ones I killed.

speaker: Deimos
text: They were suffering, Simon. I'm trying to end it. For all of them. For everyone.

speaker: Simon
text: Here. Take it.

speaker: Deimos
text: Thank you. That was kind of you.

speaker: Deimos
text: It's only a part.

speaker: Simon
text: No. I've signed enough things.

speaker: Deimos
text: Give it to me. Give it to me. It's mine. I earned it.

speaker: Simon
text: Go to hell, Deimos.

speaker: Deimos
text: You'll watch it happen slowly. With the rest of us. It's already in every pod.

speaker: Deimos
text: Bay Four will wake to whatever is out there. I only hoped to choose what.

speaker: Minerva
text: You came back. Sit.

speaker: Simon
text: I wanted to hear you say the rest.

speaker: Minerva
text: The rest is that I'm sorry. For the course change. For the pods. For all of it.

speaker: Simon
text: I'm sorry too. I signed something I shouldn't have.

speaker: Minerva
text: Tell me about her. Your daughter.

speaker: Simon
text: Nora. She's nine.

speaker: Minerva
text: The lamp's still on. You fixed that.

speaker: Nora
text: Dad. I don't need the money. Please don't go. You missed the recital, but it's okay. I kept your seat empty anyway.

speaker: Minerva
text: Say something back. Even if she can't hear it.

speaker: Simon
text: I'm okay. I should have come to the recital.

speaker: Minerva
text: You kept them.

speaker: Simon
text: I'm sorry. I can give them back.

speaker: Minerva
text: Don't. It's too late for that.

speaker: Minerva
text: I'm sorry. I'm not usually like this. I think I'm... usually someone else.

speaker: Nora
text: Dad. I don't need the money. Please don't go. You missed the recital, but it's okay. I kept your seat empty anyway.

speaker: Simon
text: I'm okay. I should have come to the recital.

speaker: It
text: Open.

speaker: Simon
text: No.

speaker: Deimos
text: Thank you. Thank you. You were the best of us.

speaker: Deimos
text: I can hear it now. Not as a hum. As a voice. It's so patient.

speaker: Simon
text: What did you do?

speaker: Deimos
text: I finished.

speaker: Deimos
text: Almost home, Marisol. Almost home, everyone.

speaker: Minerva
text: Oh. Oh, no.

speaker: Simon
text: It's going to Earth.

speaker: Simon
text: Nora's on Earth.

speaker: Simon
text: I did what I was told. Again.

speaker: Simon
text: I did it for the time. Again.

speaker: It
text: Open.

speaker: Nora
text: Dad. I don't need the money. Please don't go. You missed the recital, but it's okay. I kept your seat empty anyway.

speaker: Simon
text: The vent just stopped. I didn't hear it stop.

speaker: Simon
text: The light just flickered. Wait. It didn't.

speaker: Simon
text: I can hear it breathing. No. That's me.

speaker: Simon
text: Sorry.

speaker: Simon
text: Time. Take it. Quieter.

speaker: Simon
text: More. No. Not more. But it stopped. It stopped.

speaker: Simon
text: That went badly.

speaker: Simon
text: Don't do that again.

speaker: Simon
text: I'm still here. Why am I still here.

speaker: Simon
text: Why do I keep coming back here.

speaker: Simon
text: Quiet. Too quiet.

speaker: Simon
text: The centerpiece. It wasn't humming before.

speaker: Simon
text: It's grown. Or I'm seeing things. Both.

speaker: Simon
text: Nobody's coming. Fine. I've worked alone before.

speaker: Simon
